visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a checkered sleeveless dress over a black top, speaks animatedly to the camera while holding a smartphone. She sits on a couch in a bright studio setting with green plants and a white brick wall. She gestures with her free hand and looks directly at the lens with expressive facial movements. (2) A second girl, dressed in a black jacket and a backward black cap to portray a male character, sits down quickly next to the first woman. The scene cuts to a screen recording of an iPhone's Wi-Fi settings, showing various network names. A finger points at the screen, navigating through the list, then a FaceID unlock prompt appears over the menu. (3) The first woman reappears, now looking shocked and angry, holding the phone out and questioning the 'boyfriend' character. The second girl in the cap looks away nervously with a sheepish expression. Pink heart overlays and stylized text occasionally appear to emphasize the comedic drama.

It uses a comedic scenario of 'catching a cheating boyfriend' as a narrative hook to keep viewers engaged while demonstrating a technical feature of the iOS interface.
